name: com.alogame.sdk
description: Unity port of the Alogame native SDK bridge (Auth/Payment/Analytics/Push/Account) for Android and iOS games. Mirrors the alogame-sdk (Egret/Cocos) TypeScript API 1:1 over the same native bridge glue (OEGBridge.kt / OEGBridge.swift).

samples.description: Init + built-in login UI + logEvent/logRevenue + purchase walkthrough.
